title: Bitwise Operator
text: Specified bitwise operation on inputs, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Operator} sets Bitwise logical operator; {Use bit mask} selects to use bit, {Number of input ports} sets the number of input signals, {Bit Mask} sets the bit mask to associate with a single input and {Treat mask as} treats the mask as a real-world value or a stored integer Stored. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Operator
params.values: Bitwise logical operator AND (default) | OR | NOR | NAND | XOR | NOT

params.name: Use bit mask
params.values: Select to use bit mask checked (default) | unchecked

params.name: Bit Mask
params.values: Bit mask to associate with a single input bin2dec (default)

params.name: Treat mask as
params.values: Treat the mask as a real-world value or a stored integer Stored Integer (default) | Real World Value
